scope: Synthetic boxes only; no real identity or physical safety evidence.

greedy_iou.matching: global identity assignment counts all IoU-qualified pairs; local frame assignment maximizes match count then IoU
greedy_iou.fragmentation_definition: matched -> unmatched while GT present -> matched; absent GT alone is not an FN/fragment
greedy_iou.switch_definition: new prediction ID versus last matched ID for the same annotated GT, including across gaps
greedy_iou.limitations: No MOT ignore regions/classes/visibility preprocessing; target ID recovery is not person recognition or permission to resume follow.
